milestones.notes: ER-008 spike (18 Nov 2026): the exe builds and boots into the first PSS movie, then stalled. ER-018 (18 Nov 2026): stall fixed (local PS2Recomp patch: priority-0 threads, libmpeg Background callback, sceGsSetDefDispEnv PMODE); the game's movie player runs and the GS presents frames. ER-029 (19 Nov 2026): VBlank pacing fixed (second local patch; 59.94 Hz measured): the Agetec movie plays its 210 pictures in about 7 s as on PCSX2. ER-043 (19 Nov 2026): the movie now ends as on PCSX2 (libmpeg end checks bound to HLE; third local patch), about 4.5 s of black where the FromSoftware logo belongs, then the opening FMV plays (bottom half of the picture correct). ER-046 (22 Nov 2026): the opening FMV ends (fourth local patch: video ends on its sequence end code), the boot reaches the title screen loop, which draws nothing (black), then the attract movies. Not a playable boot. ER-058 / ER-047 (22 Nov 2026): the FromSoftware logo and the title screen show as on PCSX2, also on the attract loop's second pass (fifth local patch: LoadImage address, D2 chain mode with QWC, libgraph double buffer after the shipped code, field presentation, GS reset); menus respond; the movie pictures are now invisible. NEWGAME reaches loading, then stopped at a missing recompiled function. ER-074 (22 Nov 2026): fixed (a libvu0 function the split labels as data; our syms_to_csv.py / make_configs.py); the game runs into the opening in-engine cutscene, but only the sky draws (every 3D model missing), at single-digit FPS, no sound. ER-099 (22 Nov 2026): PCSX2 memory cards (8 MB .ps2 image or folder card) can be imported as recomp card 1 / 2 (optional, read-only copy each launch; sixth local patch): LuciDin's PCSX2 saves list on CONTINUE and one loads into gameplay (Waterfall Cavern, pause menu works, 3D models missing), so gameplay can now be tested without NEWGAME. ER-102 / ER-103 (22 Nov 2026): the 3D models draw (libvu0 HLE audit: 14 of 28 bindings wrong; 11 recompiled from the shipped code, tenth local patch: vf0 in every thread, clip handlers); the opening cutscene and gameplay from a save show in 3D, extremely slowly, no sound. Not a playable build. ER-030 (23 Nov 2026): the movie pictures show (eleventh local patch: TEST.ZTE = 0 honoured in the CPU GS backend); open: a subtle shake on logos and movies, one freeze after skipping the FMV. ER-104 (23 Nov 2026): speed profiled (gameplay: VU1 interpreter about half of the host work, CPU GS backend about 40%); twelfth local patch (speed-ups, no result change) + /Ob2: 83 -> 65 ms per frame, 12-15 FPS against the 60 FPS target (16.7 ms). ER-036 (23 Nov 2026): three EE opcode bugs fixed (thirteenth local patch: sqrt.s from ft, cvt.w.s truncates and saturates, 128-bit accesses aligned); the attack animations now play normally; speed unchanged. Needs: speed (VU1 and GS, structural), sound (ER-105).
